D: A jewellery heist goes wrong and the surviving crooks suspect one of them is a cop.
P: Serve the breakfast when the crew argues about tipping at the diner.
S: Small buttermilk pancakes stacked in threes with butter and maple syrup
Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in small rounds in butter until bubbles set, stacked in threes with butter and maple syrup.
Mr Pink's bacon and egg sliders
Mr Pink at the diner, who doesn't tip

Soft scrambled eggs, crisp streaky bacon and melted American cheese in toasted brioche slider buns with hot sauce mayo. Grill 8 rashers streaky bacon until crisp and halve. Whisk 8 eggs with salt and scramble softly in 30g butter over low heat. Toast 8 brioche slider buns. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp hot sauce. Fill each bun with egg, bacon, a half slice of American cheese and a spoon of the hot sauce mayo.
Crisp grated potato and onion cakes fried in butter
Grated potato squeezed dry, seasoned, pressed into flat cakes, fried in butter and oil until crisp and deep golden on both sides.
M: Joe's big breakfast before he hands out the colour names

Two eggs your way, thick-cut bacon, griddled pork sausages, crispy hash browns, buttered toast and a blistered tomato on a big oval plate. Grill 8 pork sausages for 15 minutes, turning. Fry 8 rashers thick-cut bacon. Halve 4 tomatoes and grill cut side down until blistered. Bake 8 hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 eggs in butter to order. Toast 8 slices of bread and butter well. Load everything onto four big plates with tomato sauce on the table.
Sliced rump steak, caramelised onions, provolone and horseradish mayo on a toasted roll
Rump steak seared and sliced, piled into a toasted roll with onions cooked slowly in butter, provolone and a horseradish mayo.
W: Tart lemon curd in a sweet pastry case under toasted meringue
Short pastry case with tangy lemon filling under a tall, toasted meringue, cut in big diner wedges.
K: Tip jar maple cream cold brew
Cold brew over ice topped with maple whipped cream

Overnight cold brew poured over ice and topped with a maple cream float, served in thick diner mugs. Tip your waitress. Stir 100g coarse ground coffee into 1L cold water and steep in the fridge for 12 hours, then strain. Whisk 150ml cream with 2 tbsp maple syrup until just thick. Fill four thick mugs or glasses with ice, pour in the cold brew and spoon the maple cream on top.

s.note: Small buttermilk pancakes stacked in threes with butter and maple syrup
s.how: Whisk 200g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 300ml buttermilk and 1 egg and rest 15 minutes. Cook small rounds in butter until bubbles set. Stack in threes with butter and maple syrup.

s.note: Crisp grated potato and onion cakes fried in butter
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes and a small onion, squeeze dry and season with fine salt. Press into flat cakes and fry in 40g butter and a little oil for 5 minutes a side until deep golden.

m.note: Sliced rump steak, caramelised onions, provolone and horseradish mayo on a toasted roll
m.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter until golden. Sear 2 rump steaks, rest and slice. Pile into 4 toasted rolls with the onions, 4 slices provolone and mayo mixed with 1 tbsp horseradish.

w.note: Tart lemon curd in a sweet pastry case under toasted meringue
w.how: Blind bake a 23cm sweet shortcrust case at 180C for 20 minutes. Cook 300ml water, 200g sugar, 40g cornflour, the juice and zest of 3 lemons and 4 egg yolks until thick, add 40g butter and pour in. Whisk 4 egg whites with 200g sugar to stiff peaks, pile on top and bake 12 minutes until golden.
